name: tiktok-yap-editor
description: Turn raw phone clips into finished vertical video for TikTok, Reels, Shorts and LinkedIn. 3.9: the restart scan hears repeats in the audio and decodes only there, the caption gate accepts your ad-libs, every decision comes at once and a rerun is seconds, yapprep reads a filming day and clauses_from_script proposes the plan. HyperFrames packaging, one gate ladder for both modes, an edit record that joins the cut to the post.
